[package]
name = "wordfreq"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
cargo build --release --locked --offline
cp target/release/wordfreq app
